subject: SIG: secure SDLC evidence — code review, CI/CD controls, secrets handling
messages:
From: Tom Lee <tlee@finsecure.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audit@finsecure.com
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: SDLC evidence request (code review / CI controls / secrets)

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As part of our SIG assessment for FinSecure's review, we need a compact package of SDLC evidence covering:
- code review enforcement (PR gating, reviewer counts, required checks)
- CI/CD controls (protected branches, pipeline RBAC, signed artifacts)
- secrets management (ephemeral credentials, vault integration, rotation cadence)
- change management (approval trails, emergency change process)

For efficiency please attach (or share links to) the following artifacts if available:
1) a sample code-review log (anonymized PR IDs and reviewers) covering May–July 2025
2) the CI control matrix or pipeline policy PDF
3) a short summary CSV of secrets rotation events for the last quarter
4) links to any runbook that documents emergency rollback/change procedures

If you can provide these by EOD Tuesday (2025-08-05) that would keep our timeline on track. If anything is sensitive, a redacted excerpt or screenshot is fine — we can sign an NDA for additional access.

Best,
Tom Lee
Senior Assessor — FinSecure Audit Team

--
Attachments: none in initial request (please attach files in reply)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lee <tlee@finsecure.com>
Cc: audit@finsecure.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SDLC evidence request (code review / CI controls / secrets)

Tom — thanks for the checklist and timeline. We're on it. A couple quick clarifications so we deliver the minimal but sufficient set:
- For the code-review log, do you prefer full PR URLs or an anonymized CSV (PR12345 -> anonymized-PR-1)?
- For the CI control matrix, we can supply the published policy and a recent pipeline run showing enforcement (protected branch + required checks) — will that work?
- Secrets: we manage secrets in Vault with short-lived roles for CI; I can provide a rotation summary and sample audit entries. Are audit log extracts acceptable if redacted?

Looping in Karthik (security engineering) and Monica (platform ops) to pull the artifacts. We'll aim to deliver a Drive folder + the three attachments directly in this thread by 2025-08-05 EOD. If you need anything sooner, call me.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

--
Internal note: tagging for artifact pull (karthik, monica).

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Lee <tlee@finsecure.com>, audit@finsecure.com
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SDLC evidence request (code review / CI controls / secrets)

Vanessa / Monica / Tom — attaching an anonymized code-review log excerpt for May–July 2025 and a short annotated README explaining columns.

Quick summary of what the attached log shows (also included in the README):
- All PRs to protected branches must have at least one approver from the owning team and must pass two CI checks (unit + static analysis).
- We enforce branch protection via GitHub with required status checks; merge blocked if checks fail.
- We require at least one reviewer and at least one approval before merging for service repos; config enforced by repo-level CODEOWNERS + org policy.

Attachments (referenced in this email):
- sdlc_code_review_log_2025Q2.csv (anonymized PR id, created_at, merged_at, reviewers, approvals, checks_passed)
- code_review_readme.txt (brief explanation of anonymization)

On the secrets question: we issue short-lived Vault tokens tied to GitHub Actions OIDC tokens; tokens are automatically revoked after 15 minutes by default for CI roles. I will add a CSV extract with rotation events and audit indexes in my next note.

-Karthik
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: sdlc_code_review_log_2025Q2.csv (CSV, 42 rows), code_review_readme.txt (plain text)

From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Lee <tlee@finsecure.com>, audit@finsecure.com
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SDLC evidence request (code review / CI controls / secrets)

Tom / Vanessa — adding CI/CD controls and secrets rotation summary.

Highlights (pulling from attached matrix and pipeline excerpt):
- CI control matrix: describes RBAC for pipeline editing (only platform ops + security on master), required checks enforced (unit, integration, static analysis), artifact signing step for release pipelines. See ci_pipeline_control_matrix_v2.pdf.
- Example pipeline run: pipeline-id 20250805-PL-9982 shows enforcement — the protected-branch merge attempt was blocked until code-scan finished; screenshot included in Drive link.
- Secrets rotation summary (secrets_rotation_summary_aug2025.csv): rotation events for service credentials (last rotated dates + responsible on-call) for June–Aug 2025. Entries are limited to service keys only; user credentials are managed in SSO and not included.

Links and access:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cC-sdlc-evidence-vanessa (contains the three attachments and a redacted audit log export).
- If you need raw audit logs we can arrange a time-limited viewer link (we'll need a signed DPA/NDA).

Let me know if you want us to pull specific run IDs or expand the rotation CSV to include a longer history.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Platform Operations — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments referenced: ci_pipeline_control_matrix_v2.pdf (PDF), secrets_rotation_summary_aug2025.csv (CSV).

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SDLC evidence request (code review / CI controls / secrets)

Tom — closing the loop from our side. Attached and shared (Drive link below) are the artifacts requested earlier:
- sdlc_code_review_log_2025Q2.csv (anonymized PRs)
- ci_pipeline_control_matrix_v2.pdf (policy + matrix)
- secrets_rotation_summary_aug2025.csv (service key rotation)

Drive folder (read-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cC-sdlc-evidence-vanessa
DocuSign reference (for additional access): DocuSign: 0Z9Y-Review-SLDC-Evidence

If FinSecure needs raw audit log extracts or raw pipeline artifacts, we can provide a time-limited viewer but will require a signed DPA/NDA per our data sharing policy — happy to start that process if needed. Otherwise please confirm receipt and whether the attached artifacts are sufficient for the SIG assessment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — team did a good job pulling these together on short notice.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0137
